title: google-deepmind/mujoco: a physics simulator for robots, a week after version 4.0.0
friendlyTitle: MuJoCo lets you test a robot in software before it moves
summary: MuJoCo simulates joints, contact, and motion. DeepMind shipped version 4.0.0 on 6 November. On GitHub's daily trending list it gained about 579 stars, with about 16,800 in total.
friendlySummary: MuJoCo is DeepMind's tool for simulating how joints and objects touch and move. Version 4.0.0 came out on 6 November. It gained about 579 stars on GitHub's daily list.
whyItMatters: Use it to train or test a robot controller in software before the hardware moves. It is a physics engine, not a chatbot. The 4.0.0 release is why it is back on the daily list.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it when you are teaching a robot or a controller, and you want to try the idea on a computer first. It does not chat. It models physical movement.
